query:
SELECT r.romfile_id AS "romfile_id!"
        FROM roms AS r
        JOIN games AS g ON r.game_id = g.id
        WHERE r.romfile_id IS NOT NULL
        AND r.parent_id IS NOT NULL
        AND r.name = ?
        AND r.size = ?
        AND r.md5 = ?
        AND (? IS NULL OR g.system_id = ?)
        LIMIT 1
